move-abroad.title: Moving to another country
move-abroad.summary: Register, get your tax number, insurance and a bank account.

start-university.title: Starting university
start-university.summary: Enrol, get your student ID, residence and health insurance.

get-oib.title: Get a personal identification number (OIB)
get-oib.summary: Needed for every other step: contracts, bank, insurance.

register-address.title: Register your new address
register-address.summary: Within 30 days of moving in. Bring the lease and the landlord's proof of ownership.

residence-permit.title: Apply for a residence permit
residence-permit.summary: Temporary stay for work or study. Fee is paid at the counter.

health-insurance.title: Register for health insurance
health-insurance.summary: Your employer registers you, but you confirm it and collect the card.

open-bank-account.title: Open a bank account
open-bank-account.summary: Needed for salary and rent. Banks ask for OIB and proof of address.

enrol.title: Enrol at the university
enrol.summary: Bring originals; the office keeps copies.

student-id.title: Get your student card (X-ica)
student-id.summary: Used for meals and transport discounts.

temporary-residence.title: Register temporary residence
temporary-residence.summary: Within 30 days of moving to the student dorm or flat.

offline.title: You're offline.
offline.body: You can read your documents and steps. Changes are blocked until you're back online.
